sentences.text: Gjyshi i Ardit ka një shtëpi në fshat.
sentences.english: Ardi's grandfather has a house in a village.

sentences.text: Shtëpia është e vjetër.
sentences.english: The house is old.

sentences.text: Ardi shkon në fshat me gjyshin.
sentences.english: Ardi goes to the village with his grandfather.

sentences.text: Rruga është e gjatë.
sentences.english: The road is long.

sentences.text: Në shtëpi ka një kuzhinë të madhe.
sentences.english: In the house there is a big kitchen.

sentences.text: Gjyshi bën kafe.
sentences.english: The grandfather makes coffee.

sentences.text: Ardi pi ujë.
sentences.english: Ardi drinks water.

sentences.text: Pastaj Ardi lexon një libër.
sentences.english: Then Ardi reads a book.

sentences.text: Ai është i lumtur që është me gjyshin.
sentences.english: He is happy to be with his grandfather.

sentences.text: Gjyshi ka një qen të madh.
sentences.english: The grandfather has a big dog.

sentences.text: Gjyshi është i lodhur.
sentences.english: The grandfather is tired.

sentences.text: Në verë Ardi nuk shkon në shkollë.
sentences.english: In summer Ardi does not go to school.

sentences.text: Ai shkon te gjyshi çdo mëngjes.
sentences.english: He goes to his grandfather every morning.

sentences.text: Gjyshi i jep Ardit bukë dhe çaj.
sentences.english: The grandfather gives Ardi bread and tea.

sentences.text: Ardi ha bukë dhe pi çaj.
sentences.english: Ardi eats bread and drinks tea.

sentences.text: Gjyshi pi kafe dhe lexon.
sentences.english: The grandfather drinks coffee and reads.

sentences.text: Në shtëpi ka shumë libra.
sentences.english: In the house there are many books.

sentences.text: Ardit i pëlqen vera shumë.
sentences.english: Ardi likes the summer very much.

sentences.text: Ai është shumë i lumtur.
sentences.english: He is very happy.

sentences.text: Në shtëpi Ardi gjen një libër të vjetër.
sentences.english: In the house Ardi finds an old book.

sentences.text: Ai pyet gjyshin: — Çfarë është ky libër?
sentences.english: He asks his grandfather: "What is this book?"

sentences.text: Gjyshi e sheh librin dhe thotë: — Është libri i gjyshes.
sentences.english: The grandfather sees the book and says: "It is grandmother's book."

sentences.text: Gjyshi është burrë i mirë.
sentences.english: The grandfather is a good man.

sentences.text: Ai njeh shumë njerëz këtu.
sentences.english: He knows many people here.

sentences.text: Ai shkruan dhe lexon çdo ditë.
sentences.english: He writes and reads every day.

sentences.text: — Sam, a do të shkosh në fshat? — pyet Luan.
sentences.english: "Sam, do you want to go to the village?" asks Luan.

sentences.text: — Po! Ku është fshati?
sentences.english: "Yes! Where is the village?"

sentences.text: — Nuk është në Tiranë. Rruga është e gjatë.
sentences.english: "It is not in Tirana. The road is long."

sentences.text: — Çfarë bëjmë?
sentences.english: "What do we do?"

sentences.text: — Pimë kafe me gjyshin e Ardit.
sentences.english: "We drink coffee with Ardi's grandfather."

sentences.text: — A ka shtëpi të vjetra?
sentences.english: "Are there old houses?"

sentences.text: — Po, ka shumë shtëpi të vjetra.
sentences.english: "Yes, there are many old houses."

sentences.text: — Shumë mirë. Më pëlqen!
sentences.english: "Very good. I like it!"

sentences.text: Në verë Sam dhe Luan shkojnë me Ardin.
sentences.english: In summer Sam and Luan go with Ardi.
